evaluation.acceptance: Pre-register a human meaningful-gain target and noninferiority margins with reviewers; no promotion until independent context-sensitive benefit and harm/latency limits pass. No fresh local DiaBLa set remains; acquire a new independent conversational test before any claim of dialogue improvement.

bootstrap.resample_unit: whole dialogue, keeping both directions together
bootstrap.warning: Mean sentence-chrF intervals do not estimate corpus chrF deltas.

evaluation.controls: Same cases/base checkpoint/decoding/current-utterance token budget; history cap6, selector cap2; charge selector time. Freeze configuration and case membership before any holdout inference.
evaluation.freeze_log: Record checkpoint/tokenizer/selector hashes, chosen thresholds, decoding, exact case IDs, source/reference hashes, context policy, all arms and predeclared acceptance rule before accessing gold.
evaluation.holdout_status: No fresh DiaBLa groups. Existing DiaBLa is regression-only. Official WMT24 valid/test are unacquired future candidates, requiring split/group/text checks BEFORE any next fitting.
evaluation.human_review: Two fluent reviewers blinded to model/arm; independent adjudication; no candidate outputs when authoring references. No claim of utility from adjacent/different-dialogue membership.
evaluation.primary: Bilingual blinded paired meaning-preservation ratings with context; harmful changes adjudicated.
secondary: paired bootstrap by dialogue for mean sentence-chrF difference
human context-sensitive accuracy: antecedents, gender/formality, ellipsis, lexical consistency
helpful rejection and harmful selection only on independently labelled memories
median/p95 latency, context tokens, truncation counts, abstention and failure rates

training.allowed_inputs: train.inputs.jsonl + joined train.references.jsonl for target loss only
training.recipe: Next experiment only after a separate explicit run plan. This package starts no run.
